name: @castellan/rust-otp
description: Turbo package for the castellan-otp Cargo crate: per-crate nextest and clippy so `turbo run test/lint --affected` can select the changed crates and their dependents. Workspace-wide Cargo invocations stay on @castellan/rust.

scripts.lint: pixi run cargo clippy -p castellan-otp --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pixi run cargo nextest run -p castellan-otp && pixi run cargo test --doc -p castellan-otp
